scores.notes: The left station view shows bright sunny daytime with lush leafy green trees around the smoke plume, whereas the right close-up of the burning house shows dark dusk lighting and bare leafless winter trees.

The right image is set on Eyford railway station platform with the burning house and its grounds completely hidden behind a distant clump of trees, showing too little of the house itself to judge (matching the unanimous unclear ruling on the companion pair).
